raw_text: Anyone else notice the sudden flood of Manipur violence posts from accounts that normally only post about South China Sea topics? The footage being shared is from May 2023 not February 2024. Chinese state media is clearly exploiting the Manipur situation to push anti-India narratives. CGTN and Global Times running coordinated coverage painting India as a failed state. Reverse image search confirms the recycled footage.
clean_text: Reddit users noticed flood of Manipur violence posts from accounts typically focused on South China Sea. Footage confirmed as recycled from May 2023. Chinese state media coordinating anti-India narrative.
